jobs.title: (Senior) Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
What We're Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.

Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

What You'll Build

  • Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

  • Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

  • Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

  • Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

  • Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

  • Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

  • Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

  • Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

  • Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

  • Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

  • Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

  • Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

  • Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

  • A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

  • Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

  • Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We help you find an apartment in the Werksviertel within walking distance of the office. We connect you with the right contacts and take the stress out of apartment hunting.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

  • Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

  • Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance.

jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

 

We are looking for a Senior Data & Analytics Product Owner to join our growing Data team at Yepoda. In this role, you will partner closely with our Head of Data & Technology to shape how we build and ship data and analytics products across the business — driving alignment with stakeholders, prototyping ideas hands-on, and making sure our data capabilities translate into real commercial outcomes.

 

Your Tasks

  • Own the company-wide analytics function, i.e., the KPI framework, reporting cadence, BI tooling/glossary, and our decision-support and reporting standards.

  • Own the product delivery roadmap for data initiatives for Yepoda's central Data analytics team.

  • Translate commercial questions (CAC/LTV, channel mix, contribution margin, cohort behaviour, inventory turnover, etc.) from Marketing, Operations, Finance and other functions into scoped, prioritized data products and repeatable analyses.

  • Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that data engineering and analytics teams can execute against without ambiguity. Be the person who closes the gap between "the business wants something" and "the team knows what to build."

  • Lead discovery and drive experimentation with stakeholders for new data capabilities, from self-serve analytics tooling to ML-powered features.

     

Your Profile

  • 3-5 years in a product management or product owner role in BI or Analytics or closely adjacent role at a relevant D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brand.

  • Strong business understanding, you think in terms of impact, not just output. Deep understanding of D2C metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, CIR/ROAS, contribution margin, cohort analytics, marketing attribution, etc).

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to operate at C-level, translating fuzzy commercial questions into sharp, defensible analyses

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving fast in a startup environment. You create structure rather than waiting for it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

 

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to modern data stack concepts (data warehouses, Self-Serve Analytics tools, ML pipelines); you don't need to build them, but knowing the landscape helps.

  • Experience writing SQL or working directly with data and AI tools such as Omni and Claude.

 

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

     

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Engine (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Mandant entwickelt innovative Decision-Intelligence-Software für datengestützte Entscheidungen und komplexe betriebliche Abläufe. Das Ziel ist es, Organisationen dabei zu helfen, Abhängigkeiten transparent zu machen, Handlungsoptionen zu evaluieren und Entscheidungen zu treffen, deren Logik und Annahmen jederzeit nachvollziehbar sind. Dafür wird eine leistungsfähige Kerntechnologie aufgebaut, die strukturiertes Wissen, logisches Schlussfolgern (Reasoning), Planung und KI-Komponenten vereint.

Als Senior Product Manager bist du das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen Marktbedürfnissen, Customer Insights und technischer Umsetzungsstärke. Deine Mission: ein sich schnell entwickelndes, marktorientiertes Produkt abzuliefern, das geschäftlichen Mehrwert, Produktvision und technische Machbarkeit perfekt ausbalanciert. Du steuerst den Produktlebenszyklus von der ersten Idee bis zum Product-Market-Fit und arbeitest dabei funktionsübergreifend mit Softwareentwicklung, Data Science, Vertrieb und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der genau das bereits erfolgreich getan hat: Produkte in einem Startup-Umfeld aufzubauen und zu skalieren.

Deine Challenges:

  • Produktstrategie & Roadmap: Führung der Produktstrategie in Abstimmung mit den Geschäftszielen sowie Übersetzung der Vision in umsetzbare Pläne.

  • Product-Market-Fit: Steuerung des Produkts von Problem-Fit über Solution-Fit bis hin zum Product-Market-Fit unter Nutzung schlanker, hypothesengeleiteter und iterativer Methoden.

  • MVP & Delivery: Definition von MVPs, schnelles Testen von Annahmen, Verkürzung der Time-to-Value und kontinuierliche Bereitstellung von Features, die reale Nutzerprobleme lösen.

  • Discovery & Research: Durchführung von Marktforschung, Wettbewerbsanalysen und Kundeninterviews (z. B. „Jobs to be Done“), um Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren.

  • Backlog & Priorisierung: Übersetzung komplexer Daten in intuitive Produktfeatures, Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs- und Data-Science-Teams sowie Nutzung von Frameworks (z. B. WSJF, RICE) zur maximierten Impact-Ausrichtung pro Release.

  • Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Pflege klarer, realistischer Roadmaps und Sicherstellung der Stakeholder-Ausrichtung durch transparente, konsistente Kommunikation, Demos und ROI-Updates.

  • KPI-Tracking: Verfolgung und Analyse zentraler Lebenszyklus-KPIs (u. a. Konvertierung, Adoption, Churn, NPS, MRR/ARR, CAC und Feature-ROI).

  • Go-to-Market Support: Unterstützung bei Produktpositionierung, Preisgestaltung und Messaging in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb und Marketing.

  • Prototyping & Tech Feasibility: Steuerung von Leichtbau-Prototypen/Demos in frühen Phasen (inkl. Koordination externer Entwickler) sowie Bewertung technischer Machbarkeiten und Umsetzungs-Kompromisse.


  • Erfahrung: Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, idealerweise in einem technologie- oder datengetriebenen B2B-Startup-Umfeld.

  • Track Record: Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Steuerung eines Produkts von Null über den MVP bis hin zur Skalierung (vorzugsweise im Kontext von SaaS, KI oder PropTech).

  • Methoden & Tools: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Product Discovery, agilen Arbeitsweisen (Scrum/Kanban) und User-Story-Erstellung; praktische Erfahrung mit Jira, Figma, Notion, SQL, BI-Tools und A/B-Testing.

  • Analytisches & Strategisches Denken: Starkes Verständnis für Produktanalysen, Business-Value-Treiber und Priorisierungs-Frameworks (z. B. WSJF, RICE); Fähigkeit zu klaren Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit und zu strategischen Pivots bei Bedarf.

  • Technische Fluenz: Solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungs-Workflows und -Architektur sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Engineering- und Data-Science-Teams zu kommunizieren.

  • Hands-on Mindset: Fähigkeit, schnelle, funktionale Prototypen mittels No-Code/Low-Code-Tools oder einfachen Skripten zu erstellen sowie Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Entwicklern.

  • Soft Skills & Führung: Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, starkes Stakeholder-Management, Growth Mindset und hohe Eigenverantwortung.

  • Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau).

Warum wir?

  • Einfluss ab Tag 1: Werde Teil eines missionsgetriebenen Teams, in dem deine Ideen und Fähigkeiten reale Produkte von Grund auf prägen.

  • Autonomie: Kurze Entscheidungswege und hohe Eigenverantwortung in einem hochkollaborativen Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Entwicklung: Gezielte Investition in deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Schulungen und Mentoring.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. 
Du hast weitreichende Projekterfahrung in unterschiedlichen Kontexten gesammelt und große Projekte erfolgreich geleitet? Dann suchen wir Dich als Senior Project Manager (all genders), um mit uns gemeinsam digitale Lösungen für die eSociety zu realisieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst große IT-Projekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz – agil, klassisch oder hybrid
  • Mit deinem interdisziplinären Team übersetzt Du Kundenanforderungen in neue und bestehende IT-Lösungen und –Prozesse, in Agilen Projekt-Setups agierst du dabei als Product Owner
  • Du setzt Projekte in einem vielfältigen technologischen Umfeld um – von Content und Formular Management Systemen (CMS, FMS) über Lowcode-Plattformen, Entwicklung individueller Fachanwendungen bis hin zu Workplace und Cloud
  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit zu Fragen der digitalen Transformation und berätst zu Lösungen aus dem ]init[-Portfolio
  • Du übernimmst die Steuerung großer interdisziplinärer Projektteams und das Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen verschiedenen Stakeholdern
  • Du bringst deine Stärken in der Gestaltung & Moderation von Workshops mit Kunden ein und entwickelst Strategien zur effizienten Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen
  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in der Zusammenarbeit nach intern und extern, erarbeitest zielgerichtete Handlungsempfehlungen und gestaltest Veränderungsprozesse proaktiv
  • Du entwickelst unser Methoden-Toolset weiter und leitest PM-Kolleg:innen an, denn fachliche Führungsverantwortung gehört bei uns ab Senior-Level dazu


Das bringst du mit

  • Websites, Intranets, Apps, digitale Antragssysteme oder Fachanwendungen: Du begeisterst dich für die Umsetzung von herausragenden IT-Projekten
  • Du hast 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von IT-Projekten gesammelt und Project Leadership verinnerlicht
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen oder klassischen Projektmethoden und rundest mit einer Zertifizierung idealerweise dein Profil ab (z.B. PMI/PMP, Prince2, IPMA oder Scrum PSPO/PSM, LeSS, SAFe Agilist)
  • Du hast Freude an komplexen technischen Fragestellungen, am Austausch mit Kunden und bringst ein Gespür für deren Bedürfnisse mit und hast sich daraus ergebende Vertriebspotentiale immer im Blick
  • Mit Deinem Kommunikationsgeschick bewegst Du Dich souverän auf allen Ebenen der Projektorganisation, vermittelst komplexe Themen klar und adressatengerecht
  • Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium 
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Jabeena Malik

jobs.description:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.

We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

As our Founding Product Manager, you will help determine what BoWatt builds, why we build it, and whether it creates meaningful value for customers.

You will work closely across our commercial, customer success and engineering teams, as well as with our customers. You will develop a deep understanding of complex engineering workflows, turn customer problems into clear product opportunities, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

This is a hands-on product role. You will spend time with customers, work through technical and operational detail, write requirements, make trade-offs, test solutions, and help the team ship quickly.

  • Lead product discovery - translate complex workflows and customer needs into clear product requirements and success criteria

  • Develop a deep understanding of how manufacturing and systems-engineering teams work

  • Identify and define the highest-value customer problems for BoWatt to solve

  • Help own and prioritise the product roadmap

  • Balance strategic opportunities, recurring customer needs, commercial importance, and engineering effort

  • Drive product initiatives from initial discovery through scoping, development, launch, and iteration

  • Give engineers the context and clarity needed to make strong implementation decisions

  • Prototype and test potential solutions with customers before and during development

  • Work with Customer Success to turn individual customer feedback into scalable product improvements

  • Use qualitative feedback and product data to understand adoption and evaluate whether features are working

  • Triage product issues and bugs, make clear prioritisation decisions, and coordinate with Engineering

  • Improve BoWatt’s processes for discovery, prioritisation, product delivery, launches, and feedback

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt’s product, customers, and target industries

During your first six months, you will work closely with our engineering team to build the domain and product knowledge required to take ownership of increasingly important product areas.

You

  • You are deeply curious about customers and want to understand how their work actually happens

  • You enjoy turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear product decisions

  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You can distinguish between an individual customer request and a scalable product opportunity

  • You make thoughtful trade-offs and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information

  • You write clearly, communicate confidently, and know how to get to the point

  • You are comfortable working closely with software engineers and discussing technical constraints

  • You move quickly without losing sight of product quality or customer outcomes

  • You take ownership of results rather than simply managing tickets and meetings

  • You want to build a product function rather than inherit an established playbook

  • You are ambitious, resourceful, and excited to become an expert in a complex industry

Requirements

  • At least two years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Operations, or a comparable product-building role

  • Experience shipping B2B software in close collaboration with engineers

  • Experience conducting product discovery and translating customer problems into clear requirements

  • Strong prioritisation, project management, and stakeholder-management skills

  • The ability to understand technical products and communicate with engineers, technical users, and business stakeholders

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Four days per week in our Munich office at Balanstraße

  • Experience with enterprise software, AI products, manufacturing, engineering, systems engineering, or early-stage startups is a bonus

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool (5-10%)

  • Significant ownership over an important part of BoWatt’s product

  • The opportunity to help build BoWatt’s product function and ways of working

  • 25 vacation days per year, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • WellPass membership

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

 

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, making difficult trade-offs, and being responsible for the results.

 

As our Founding Product Manager, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and take meaningful ownership of how BoWatt’s product develops. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

Interview process

  1. 20-minute screening call

  2. 90-minute live product case (CEO and team member)

  3. 60-minute culture interview (CEO)

  4. Reference checks & Offer

We aim to complete the entire interview process within 14 days.

jobs.description:
You are the one we miss!

  • 4-5 years of experience in digital project management form your foundation, ideally with a focus on brand and campaign projects; a Scrum certification is a plus

jobs.title: E-Mail Campaign Producer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen jemanden, der gute Texte und gutes Design zusammenbringt und daraus fertige Newsletter baut.

Kurz zu uns: Wir sind Rügamer & Steiner aus Düsseldorf, über 35 Leute, und wir machen E-Mail-Marketing für mehr als 150 Online-Shops. In Zahlen: 8 E-Mails pro Sekunde, 250 Millionen Empfänger im Jahr. Jede einzelne Zeile davon hat jemand von uns geschrieben & designt.

Du hast schon im Marketing, mit Content oder an digitalen Kampagnen gearbeitet und dabei Texte geschrieben oder Inhalte gestaltet. Bei uns bringst du beides zusammen und baust den ganzen Newsletter selbst fertig.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben liegen morgens bereit. Ein Shop braucht einen Sale-Newsletter, der nächste stellt eine neue Kategorie vor. Du liest dich ins Briefing ein, überlegst dir den Aufbau, schreibst Betreffzeile und Text, ziehst dir die Blöcke aus unserem Figma-Designsystem und passt die Grafiken an, teilweise mit KI. Dann geht der Newsletter zur Freigabe an den Kunden und raus.

Du betreust 30 bis 40 Marken. Nach ein paar Wochen weißt du, wie jede einzelne klingt und aussieht.

Qualifikation

  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft: Bei uns wird Vollgas gegeben, 100 % vor Ort mit dem Team in Düsseldorf.
  • Gespür für Text und Gestaltung: Du hast ein Auge dafür, was gut aussieht, und ein Gefühl dafür, welche Worte passen.
  • Extrem schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Neue Tools lernst du in Tagen.
  • Ehrgeiz und Eigenantrieb: Du nimmst Feedback an und wirst mit jeder Woche besser.
  • Du gehst selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools um.
  • Du arbeitest gut und schnell. Du baust Texte, die verkaufen, und Designs, die überzeugen.
  • Du willst das ganze Ding verantworten, nicht nur deinen Teil davon.

Figma, Newsletter oder Designausbildung? Kein Muss.

Auge, Tempo und Einstellung entscheiden. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Benefits

  • Kein internes Ping-Pong. Du gibst deinen Text nicht weiter und wartest, was zurückkommt. Du baust den Newsletter selbst zu Ende.
  • Der ganze Newsletter gehört dir: Text, Aufbau, Bildwelt. Du gibst die Richtung vor.
  • Deine Arbeit geht raus. An echte Kunden echter Marken, nicht in eine Ablage. Und du kriegst mit, wie sie gelaufen ist.
  • 30 bis 40 Marken parallel. In einem Jahr machst du hier mehr Kampagnen als woanders in fünf.
  • 3.500 bis 6.000 € im Monat. Ziel jeder Einstellung ist die unbefristete Übernahme.
  • Modernes Büro in Düsseldorf Pempelfort mit Dachterrasse und ÖPNV-Anschluss.
  • Beste Hardware von Apple, höhenverstellbare Tische.
  • Junges Team und Geschäftsführung
  • Pluxee Card
  • Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft
  • Apple-Hardware
  • Aktive Arbeit mit modernster KI
  • Monatliche Teamevents

Rügamer & Steiner ist eine inhabergeführte Agentur für E-Mail- & CRM-Marketing im E-Commerce, gegründet von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner in Düsseldorf. Wir bauen für über 150 Online-Shops im DACH-Raum E-Mail-Marketing, das wirklich Umsatz bringt. Wir messen uns an Ergebnissen, nicht an Stunden und bringen jeden weiter, der bereit ist, dafür zu arbeiten.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Digital Communications (all genders)
jobs.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du möchtest digitale Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv gestalten und gemeinsam mit deinen Kund:innen weiterentwickeln? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) übernimmst du Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle digitale Kommunikationsprojekte – mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Content.
Dabei verbindest du eine sichere Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte mit einem guten Gespür für die Bedarfe deiner Kund:innen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale, bringst die richtigen Expert:innen zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen erfolgreiche digitale Lösungen in der Umsetzung werden.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs.
  • Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf digitalen Kommunikationsprojekten – insbesondere CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit Teams aus Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation, Content und UX zusammen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen und interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen, verstehst Anforderungen und Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in konkrete Projektziele und Lösungen.
  • Für dich endet Projektmanagement nicht mit der erfolgreichen Delivery: Du erkennst neue Bedarfe und Potenziale bei bestehenden Kund:innen und entwickelst Projekte und Kundenbeziehungen gemeinsam mit unseren Fachexpert:innen weiter.
  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Projektperspektive in Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Pitches ein. Wenn du hier bereits Erfahrung mitbringst, umso besser – wenn nicht, kannst du dich bei uns gezielt in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln.
  • Du steuerst unterschiedliche Stakeholder souverän und sorgst auch in komplexen Projektsituationen für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und eine gute Zusammenarbeit.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte – idealerweise rund um Websites, Informationsplattformen oder andere CMS-basierte Lösungen.
  • Du verstehst Projektmanagement nicht als reine Verwaltung, sondern möchtest Projekte, Lösungen und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Kund:innen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Du bist sowohl in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams als auch mit Disziplinen wie Kommunikation, UX, Design, Kreation oder Content sicher unterwegs.
  • Erfahrung in Presales, Business Development, Ausschreibungen oder Angebotserstellung ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss.
  • Ob agil oder klassisch: Du kennst unterschiedliche Projektmethoden und setzt sie passend zur jeweiligen Situation ein. Eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus Projekten im Public Sector oder in public-nahen Branchen mit.
  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings und Zertifizierungen entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.

Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du möchtest digitale Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv gestalten und gemeinsam mit deinen Kund:innen weiterentwickeln? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) übernimmst du Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle digitale Kommunikationsprojekte – mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Content.
Dabei verbindest du eine sichere Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte mit einem guten Gespür für die Bedarfe deiner Kund:innen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale, bringst die richtigen Expert:innen zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen erfolgreiche digitale Lösungen in der Umsetzung werden.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs.
  • Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf digitalen Kommunikationsprojekten – insbesondere CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit Teams aus Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation, Content und UX zusammen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen und interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen, verstehst Anforderungen und Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in konkrete Projektziele und Lösungen.
  • Für dich endet Projektmanagement nicht mit der erfolgreichen Delivery: Du erkennst neue Bedarfe und Potenziale bei bestehenden Kund:innen und entwickelst Projekte und Kundenbeziehungen gemeinsam mit unseren Fachexpert:innen weiter.
  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Projektperspektive in Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Pitches ein. Wenn du hier bereits Erfahrung mitbringst, umso besser – wenn nicht, kannst du dich bei uns gezielt in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln.
  • Du steuerst unterschiedliche Stakeholder souverän und sorgst auch in komplexen Projektsituationen für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und eine gute Zusammenarbeit.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte – idealerweise rund um Websites, Informationsplattformen oder andere CMS-basierte Lösungen.
  • Du verstehst Projektmanagement nicht als reine Verwaltung, sondern möchtest Projekte, Lösungen und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Kund:innen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Du bist sowohl in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams als auch mit Disziplinen wie Kommunikation, UX, Design, Kreation oder Content sicher unterwegs.
  • Erfahrung in Presales, Business Development, Ausschreibungen oder Angebotserstellung ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss.
  • Ob agil oder klassisch: Du kennst unterschiedliche Projektmethoden und setzt sie passend zur jeweiligen Situation ein. Eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus Projekten im Public Sector oder in public-nahen Branchen mit.
  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings und Zertifizierungen entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.

Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

jobs.title: Data Scientist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to change the market?

Are you a passionate and experienced Data Scientist, excited to work on improving and maintaining our data architecture? Join us to become a part of our strong international team that is transforming the traditional debt collection industry with innovation and a drive for excellence.


Your Responsibilities:

  • work as part of our Outbound Data Science team to further optimize our innovative product based on machine learning and artificial intelligence
  • work on advanced and demanding AI fields such as Reinforcement and Q learning
  • identify, understand, structure and solve complex problems
  • work on projects that deliver measurable value to our business
  • experiment with new technologies and acquire new skills to find clever solutions to the unique challenges we face
  • communicate between all stakeholders (data scientists, lead developers, product management, business owners) and present technical product concepts


What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, ideally in a startup or fintech company
  • experience with Python and with data processing packages (e.g. Pandas, Numpy) 
  • familiarity with web frameworks like Flask or FastAPI
  • knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
  • track-record of successful projects using machine learning to solve business problems
  • experience with agile development practices such as TDD/BDD, continuous integration, refactoring, code reviews, etc.
  • excellent English speaking and writing skills

Things that will make you stand out: 

  • a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics or similar
  • experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g. pytorch, scikit-learn, transformers)
  • hands-on experience with deployment of (ideally open source) LLMs (hosting, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, evaluation)
  • experience with Reinforcement Learning 
  • experience with cloud-based infrastructure solutions, such as AWS

Transparency, Execution, Ownership, Customer Centricity, Innovation and Integrity are important to us and we at PAIR Finance embody these values. Do you find yourself in these values? Then become part of our team and complement us with your individual motivation and character!


Our offer for you:

  • For this mid-level role, our salary band is €58,000 - €73,000 gross per year (based on a 40-hour work week). The exact offer will reflect your experience and qualifications
  • Thriving, financially stable company
  • Strong experienced international team to support and mentor you along the way, and a smooth onboarding process
  • International team of 30+ nationalities with professionals and experts
  • Flat hierarchy, transparent and appreciative feedback culture, monthly all-hands meetings, annual feedback and evaluation cycle, and regular 1-on-1s with your lead
  • Well-structured onboarding process as well as supportive and welcoming colleagues
  • Personal learning & development budget as well as German and English language courses
  • Unlimited employment contract, flexible working hours, and 28 vacation days for your work-life balance
  • Company pension plan, partly covered Deutschlandticket (public transport) and access to “Corporate Benefits” voucher platform to ensure your full well-being
  • Fun company summer and Christmas parties as well as regular team events
  • This role is based in Berlin, and we have a hybrid working policy. Modern office near Uhlandstraße is complete with fresh fruit, muesli, and drinks for a comfortable and enjoyable workplace


Who is your contact person?

Your contact person for this position is Geneva Brooks. If you have any questions, please contact us directly by email ----- For more information about PAIR Finance, please take a look at our website and our careers page. We look forward to hearing from you!

Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

What You'll Do

Product Management

  • Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.

  • Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.

  • Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.

  • Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.

  • Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.

  • Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.

  • Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

Execution and Individual Contribution

  • Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.

  • A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan.

Preferred Qualifications

Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days)

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  • Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

jobs.title: Product Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Product Design Engineer – Sustaining & Improvement

Location:
Concept House, Brackenbeck Road, Bradford, BD7 2LW

Reports To:
Technical Manager

Salary
Salary is negotiable and will reflect the successful candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications.

Job Purpose

Debar designs and manufactures bifold door hardware and complete bifold door systems for customers in the UK and international markets. As we invest in future growth, new product development and the continued improvement of our existing product portfolio, we are creating a new Product Design Engineer position within our Technical Engineering team.

The primary focus of the role will be the ongoing engineering integrity, design improvement and evolution of Debar's released products. The successful candidate will investigate product issues, develop engineering solutions and lead the technical content of product changes.

While the principal focus will be existing products, the role will also contribute to larger product improvements and new development projects according to business priorities and team capacity.

Our products integrate precision mechanical hardware with aluminium profiles, requiring strong mechanical design judgement and an understanding of how changes can affect the performance of the wider bifold door system.

Key Responsibilities

Product Sustaining, Improvement & Engineering Change

  • Take technical design ownership of engineering issues and improvements relating to Debar's existing bifold hardware, systems and wider released product portfolio.
  • Investigate product failures, recurring issues, customer complaints and warranty matters, developing robust engineering solutions and corrective product improvements where required.
  • Redesign components and assemblies where required to improve performance, reliability, durability or cost.
  • Assess the wider impact of proposed changes on mating components, aluminium profiles and overall system performance.
  • Carry out tolerance analysis and tolerance stack-ups where required to resolve fit, function or performance issues.
  • Lead the engineering content of product change requests, ensuring changes are properly assessed, documented and progressed through Debar's engineering change process.
  • Create and update 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, specifications and Bills of Materials associated with product changes.
  • Own and maintain the technical content of documentation for released products, including end-user, fabrication and installation manuals, technical bulletins and supporting product information.
  • Maintain accurate technical product data and configurations within relevant industry software, including Logikal, ensuring that approved profiles, hardware, rules and product changes are correctly reflected.
  • Support product changes arising from supplier changes, material changes, component availability, obsolescence or alternative manufacturing requirements.
  • Identify and progress opportunities for proactive product improvement and value engineering.

Testing, Technical Issues & Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Debar's Compliance & Testing function to support testing or validation required as a result of product changes.
  • Support prototype components, trials and validation activity where required.
  • Liaise with customers, system partners and internal commercial teams on technical issues relating to existing products, investigating concerns and developing appropriate engineering solutions.
  • Work with suppliers on technical issues, alternative components, tooling changes and manufacturing feasibility.
  • Communicate the technical implications of product changes clearly to relevant internal and external stakeholders.

Product Development Support

  • Contribute to larger improvements and enhancements to Debar's existing bifold hardware and systems.
  • Support new product and system development projects according to business priorities and Technical Engineering resource requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with Product Development engineers on projects requiring shared expertise or additional capacity.

Person Specification

Essential Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • Degree, HND or equivalent recognised higher-level qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering or a closely related discipline. A relevant formal qualification is mandatory.
  • Relevant professional experience in mechanical design, product design or product development engineering.
  • Strong capability in parametric 3D CAD and manufacturing-ready engineering drawings.
  • Experience designing and modifying physical products or components for manufacture.
  • Strong understanding of Design for Manufacture, dimensional tolerances, engineering fits and tolerance stack-up analysis.
  • Practical understanding of mechanical engineering, materials and relevant manufacturing processes.
  • Strong mechanical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to progress engineering work independently while collaborating effectively across different functions.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Fenestration, windows, doors, aluminium architectural systems or other moving door systems.
  • Mechanical or architectural hardware such as hinges, rollers, guides, handles or locks.
  • Small precision components involving aluminium extrusions, zinc or aluminium castings, mouldings or CNC-machined parts.
  • Product sustaining engineering, continuous product improvement or engineering change.
  • Failure investigation, corrective product redesign, value engineering or component substitution.
  • Product testing, validation, tooling or supplier development.
  • Autodesk Inventor is strongly preferred; experienced SolidWorks, Creo or comparable CAD users will also be considered. AutoCAD and ERP experience would be beneficial.
  • Producing controlled technical product documentation or maintaining product and configuration data within Logikal or comparable industry software.

Direct experience designing or improving bifold door hardware or systems would be particularly valuable but is not an essential requirement.

Attributes

  • Practical, curious and interested in understanding how mechanical products perform and can be improved.
  • Methodical and detail-conscious when managing engineering changes.
  • Able to balance product performance, quality, manufacturability and cost.
  • Collaborative, self-motivated and comfortable taking technical ownership of defined issues and projects.

Working Conditions

  • Full-time, permanent role based primarily at Debar’s Bradford facility, with one day per week homeworking currently available.
  • Occasional travel may be required for supplier visits, product trials, customer projects or testing.

jobs.description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Fully Remote (Global)

Classification: Full-time; 40 hours per week

Pay Range: €51,000-90,000

Experience: 2+ years as a QA engineer

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School. Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

▶️ You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

The Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases.

As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool.

A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time.

What You'll Do

  • Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers

  • Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet)

  • Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail

  • File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve

  • Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship

  • Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria

  • Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4)

How We Work

We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer.

We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality:

Meetings (yes, we keep them minimal):

  • Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other..

  • Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint.

  • 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda.

  • Monthly Engineering all-hands.

  • That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work.

Deployments:

  • Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release.

  • Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes

Communication:

  • Async-friendly. Documentation-first.

  • Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion

  • Google Workspace for email and documents.

  • Zoom for video calls.

Timezone:

  • We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet.


What We're Looking For

Requirements (Requisite Skills): 

  • 2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing

  • 2+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer)

  • 2+ years of experience using TypeScript

  • Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklists, and test documentation

  • Familiarity with QA's role in the SDLC and how to collaborate with developers and PMs

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Upper-intermediate English (B2+) for written and spoken communication

  • Strong experience in manual testing and writing manual test cases

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accessibility and/or security testing

How you’ll work with other teams:

Career Growth

We have a defined career ladder. Whether your path leads toward Senior/Staff QA Engineer or Engineering Management, there's room to grow - and we'll work with you to get there.

Onboarding

Every team member gets full support throughout onboarding, and no one expects you to figure out the ins and outs on your own. We'll pair with you, answer every question, and make sure you have the context you need. New hires typically feel very supported at Miaplaza.

What success looks like here: In the first couple of months, you're asking a lot of clarifying questions, reading documentation, exploring the product independently, and writing and running tests with confidence. By months 3-4, you're taking ownership of a specific area, building out test coverage, identifying gaps, and driving quality improvements. By month 5-6, you're contributing meaningfully to the testing strategy for migration and modernisation work and operating independently. The common thread: curiosity, initiative, and the habit of investigating before you ask, but always asking when you need to.

Interview Process

Our process is staged and designed to respect your time. Expect a mix of introductory conversation, technical discussion, and practical evaluation. We want to understand how you think about real problems and testing practices. As part of the process, we will ask for professional references and conduct a background check in accordance with applicable law. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, let us know, we're happy to help.

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to negotiation based on your experience and expertise. We'll discuss specifics early in the process so neither side wastes time. Since we’re remote-first, every arrangement is different; we tailor time off, benefits, and perks as part of your individual contract to ensure the overall package works for both sides.

Ready to apply?

Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves a screening call, followed by a behavioral interview, and two technical interviews.

About koppla

At koppla, we're a fun and ambitious team on a mission to help the construction industry build more efficiently. We're already partnering with top construction companies and delivering impressive results for our customers (multi-months speed-ups discovered through koppla).

Our ambitions are backed by leading VCs (Earlybird, Newion) and industry angels as we tackle a billion-dollar opportunity problem in an underdigitized and underserved market.

Our culture is core to who we are and we've built one we're genuinely proud of. We are not looking for hypergrowth - we believe in hiring slowly to create an environment of few but very high-performing team members that build a truly great product (similar to Netflix, Ashby or Linear).


What you'll be doing

Our Tech Stack: 
  • Frontend: Typescript, Vue 3, Tailwind, Netlify, GH Actions 
  • Backend: Typescript, AWS, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, REST, Websockets, Terraform, GH Actions


Who we're looking for

This role is perfect for a Frontend/Full Stack Engineer with 2-5 years of experience looking to grow their skills and make a meaningful impact at a company that is approaching product-market fit (> €2.5M ARR). You are likely a great fit if:

Beyond the role-specific requirements, you also see your own values reflected in our Culture Playbook.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

  • Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

  • Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

  • Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

  • Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

  • Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

  • Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

  • Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

  • Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

  • Participate in Security Incident response

Qualifications

  • Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

  • Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

  • Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

  • Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

  • Can write security tests and develop exploits and proof-of-concepts that find real vulnerabilities in a product

  • Understand AI/ML security risks and mitigations, including prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and adversarial attacks

  • Have practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, reconnaissance, and pentesting workflows

  • Have a track record of building security programs and automations from scratch, applying risk-based prioritization

  • Have experience performing security reviews and building or improving security review automation

  • Have excellent communication skills, allowing you to explain complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Understand industry standards, and actively keep up with emerging security technologies and models

  • Are a team player who drives security change via collaboration and cross-functional partnerships

  • Hold offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CRTO

  • Have published CVEs, original security research, or conference talks

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with container escape, Kubernetes attack paths, or cloud red teaming

  • Have experience testing AI/ML systems for issues like prompt injection, model extraction, and data poisoning

What to Expect

First 30 days:

  • Meet with security team and key partners across engineering

  • Gain access to team owned systems, and internal documentation

  • Complete security awareness training and compliance onboarding

  • Review application architecture, tech stack and data flow

  • Review risk registry and annual roadmap

  • Familiarize oneself with team workflows and processes

  • Shadow a fellow security engineer during their on-call/secops rotations

First 90 days:

  • Conduct security review on emerging Docker products

  • Scope and execute your first penetration test against a Docker product or service

  • Actively participate in architecture design reviews with the team

  • Contribute to a Security-owned project or initiative

  • Collaborate with Docker developers to validate and resolve discovered vulnerabilities

  • Enhance incident response capabilities by participating in on-call rotation and post-incident activities

  • Create and maintain security documentation and runbooks

First Year Outlook

  • Contribute to the security roadmap for improving security controls

  • Strengthen Zero Trust architecture and least privilege access controls

  • Enhance security monitoring and anomaly detection

  • Perform security reviews for major product releases

  • Own and run recurring penetration tests and adversary-emulation exercises across Docker products, and engage with external researchers

  • Support audits and ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27xxx

  • Advocate for “security by design” in all product features

  • Become well versed in Docker products and emerging AI technologies

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

EU: €118,860 – €169,800+ equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

jobs.description:
At NewOrbit Space, our mission is to engineer the lowest orbiting satellites on Earth to rapidly advance global connectivity and insight.
