jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Mechanical Design Engineer – Product Development

Location:
Concept House, Brackenbeck Road, Bradford, BD7 2LW

Reports To:
Technical Manager

Salary:
Salary is negotiable and will reflect the successful candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications.

Job Purpose

Debar designs and manufactures bifold door hardware and complete bifold door systems for customers in the UK and international markets. As we invest in future growth and an expanding product pipeline, we are creating a new Mechanical Design Engineer position within our Technical Engineering team.

Our development work follows two complementary routes: collaborating with external systems houses and industry partners to create hardware solutions for their door systems; and developing Debar's own proprietary or white-label bifold and other system solutions for selected global markets.

The role may support either or both routes. The successful candidate will take mechanical components and assemblies from concept through detailed design, prototyping, testing and production, while contributing technical expertise in discussions with customers and partners where required.

Our products integrate precision hardware with aluminium profiles, so sound judgement around tolerances, fit, movement, materials and manufacturing methods is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Product & System Development

  • Design and develop mechanical components, assemblies and product concepts for bifold door hardware and systems, together with other products as required.
  • Work with systems houses, fabricators and industry partners to understand technical requirements and develop hardware solutions that integrate effectively with their systems.
  • Design and develop Debar’s proprietary and white-label bifold and other system solutions for introduction into appropriate global markets.
  • Create accurate 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, specifications and Bills of Materials.
  • Take designs from initial concept through detailed engineering, prototype, testing, validation and production release.
  • Consider how hardware interacts with aluminium profiles and the complete door system, including alignment, movement, adjustment, load transfer and long-term performance.
  • Carry out tolerance analysis and tolerance stack-ups to achieve reliable fit, function and manufacturability.
  • Undertake appropriate engineering calculations and analysis to substantiate design decisions and product performance.
  • Contribute ideas for future products and provide practical engineering input into product and system opportunities.

Manufacture, Testing & Engineering Control

  • Apply Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DFM/DFA) principles across relevant processes including machining, extrusion, die casting, injection moulding, pressing and mechanical assembly.
  • Work with Production, Quality and the wider Supply Chain to resolve manufacturing, tooling, quality and cost considerations.
  • Support prototype builds, product testing and the structured investigation of issues arising during development and product launch.
  • Maintain drawing revisions and engineering change records, ensuring design changes are controlled and validated.
  • Improve and value-engineer existing products without compromising performance or quality.
  • Refine and value-engineer products during development and launch without compromising performance or quality.

Technical & Partner Collaboration

  • Communicate technical concepts, design decisions and development progress clearly to colleagues, customers, system partners and suppliers.
  • Translate commercial, customer or system requirements into practical, manufacturable engineering solutions.

Person Specification

Essential Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • Degree, HND or equivalent recognised higher-level qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering or a closely related discipline. A relevant formal qualification is mandatory and experience alone will not be accepted as an alternative.
  • Relevant professional experience in mechanical design, product design or product development engineering.
  • Strong capability in parametric 3D CAD and manufacturing-ready engineering drawings.
  • Experience designing physical products or components for manufacture rather than CAD modelling alone.
  • Practical understanding of mechanical engineering, materials and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong understanding of Design for Manufacture, dimensional tolerances, engineering fits and tolerance stack-up analysis.
  • Methodical mechanical problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to progress defined engineering work independently while contributing effectively to a wider team.
  • Confidence communicating technical information with customers and partners.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Fenestration, windows, doors, aluminium architectural systems or other moving door systems.
  • Mechanical or architectural hardware such as hinges, rollers, guides, handles or locks.
  • Small precision components involving aluminium extrusions, castings, mouldings or CNC-machined parts.
  • Product testing, New Product Introduction, value engineering, tooling or supplier development.
  • Autodesk Inventor is strongly preferred; experienced SolidWorks, Creo or comparable CAD users will also be considered. AutoCAD and ERP experience would be beneficial.

Direct experience designing bifold door hardware or systems would be particularly valuable but is not an essential requirement.

Attributes

  • Practical, curious and interested in how mechanical products and systems work.
  • Able to balance product performance, manufacturability, quality and cost.
  • Credible and confident in technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborative, self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of defined projects.
  • Enthusiastic about joining a business investing in product development and future growth.

Working Conditions

  • Full-time, permanent role based primarily at Debar’s Bradford facility, with one day per week homeworking currently available.
  • Occasional travel may be required for supplier visits, product trials, customer projects or testing.

👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

  • Build Our Market Presence: Draft posts for our company page and keep our content calendar running: webinars and event announcements, product news, new joiners, and the pieces that build our positioning in the market.

CRM: Hubspot

Content & design: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Figma

Messaging: Slack & Google Workspace

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

  • Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

  • Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required.
  • Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth.
  • Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth.

Benefits

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Very generous employee discount after probation period
  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

About us:

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Java
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Connect team, reporting to Rémi Fouilloux, Senior Engineering Manager. The team is split between Bordeaux and Paris.

Together, you'll be building and scaling Mirakl Connect, an innovative solution that simplifies sellers' daily lives through a central hub powered by the latest advances in AI.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

Your Impact

  • Drive technical excellence: Take ownership of user stories, conduct code reviews, and actively contribute to design, development, testing, and production deployments
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Develop roadmaps with R&D, align priorities with other tech leads, and partner with product and design teams to deliver on commitments with high velocity and quality
  • Develop talent and best practices: Ensure successful onboarding, identify and nurture team talent, contribute to recruitment, and establish best practices in clean code, testing, and pair programming
  • Remove blockers and enable success: Step in to resolve technical challenges, make arbitration decisions, and ensure the team delivers on its commitments
  • Lead and grow your team: Manage and mentor 4-5 developers, conducting one-on-ones, performance reviews, and fostering team cohesion and motivation across distributed locations
  • Participate in the adoption of AI : within our products but also in internal practices 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of Java development experience with recent versions
  • Minimum 2 years in a team lead or similar management role, mentoring developers
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people management
  • Track record of delivering complex projects in a microservices environment
  • Professional proficiency in English 

Skills:

  • Java development and architecture
  • Team leadership and mentoring
  • Technical decision-making and problem-solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Clean code and engineering best practices

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

Interview steps:

  1. 30/45-minute call with someone from the recruitment team to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 45-minute technical interview on Google Meet with an experienced developer to discuss our technical stack and assess your knowledge
  3. 1-hour business discussion with the Senior Engineering Manager 
  4. 2 x 45-minute STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders 

More information about our recruitment philosophy 👉 3 tips to shine in STAR interviews at Mirakl

 

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.
